auditor.name: JAIN SARAOGI & CO LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Non-obtaining of actuarial valuation for employee benefit obligations as per Ind AS 19; 2) Non-redemption of 11% Redeemable Cumulative Preference Shares due by September 2000 and non-provision for cumulative dividends of Rs 273.38 lakhs up to March 31, 2025 and Rs 21.65 lakhs for FY 2025-26. Emphasis of matter on impairment loss of Rs 1933.88 lakhs on CWIP in FY 2024-25 and additional Rs 332.64 lakhs in FY 2025-26, and material uncertainty related to going concern with net worth of (-) Rs 3279.16 lakhs and current liabilities exceeding current assets by Rs 1365.17 lakhs.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to continuing losses and negative net worth
Dependence on proposed support from incoming investor under Share Purchase Agreement
Non-compliance with Ind AS 19 for employee benefits
Unredeemed preference shares and unprovided cumulative dividends
